formalApplicability.limitation: The formal models are bounded abstractions; this source does not compare a generated trace or prove exact fixture rows, full persistence, or runtime success.

replacementProof.gap: Before any consolidation, prove that the legacy zero/one/many witness IDs and every related Observation row fit the canonical first-2,000-Patient, 2-to-22-many contract. Preserve exact ALL_MATCHES and EXISTS ERROR/PRESERVE_PARENT/EXCLUDE results, diagnostics, policy edits, source identities, Cancel/Apply, and reload/removal restoration. The legacy workflow only checks proposal DOM rows; establish equivalent native request/response CAS, receipt, candidate-construction equivalence, complete and non-sampled preview checks, and an error/performance census in the registered route. Also decide whether the generic-Playwright-only `standalone-misc-cda-unmapped` invocation must remain; it has no registry `requiredChecks` contract.

Check mode rejects generated JSON that no longer appears in the exact registered case.

The migration rejects duplicate family destinations and a test that matches more than one approved family.
The migration planner rejects previously generated focused checks that no current reviewed family owns, preventing silent check removal.

scriptInventoryBounds: The source catalog is hash-bound to reviewed revisions; currentSha256 records each active file at generation time. Configured focused commands and sourceFiles are separate registry connections; sourceFiles and literal import candidates are not execution evidence. Only an explicit per-case summary with a passed focused group, exact planned command stage, unchanged complete inputs, and matching current input hashes records focused-command-passed for the command test file. This never upgrades a case, journey, or formal-model result. Semantic claims and formal bindings remain intended associations; retired rows preserve their source and replacement references.
